subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: Should manifest diagnostics become a stable status output, and should prompt-only skill activation extend the structured `skill.used` contract or produce a user-visible warning?
rationale: The enhancement gaps are source-proven, but status performance, output compatibility, and warning noise cannot be resolved safely without maintainer intent.

options.title: Bounded status plus telemetry
options.body: Expose lightweight actionable manifest diagnostics in selected status modes and extend structured skill telemetry with a prompt-only activation classification.

options.title: Split focused follow-ups
options.body: Track status diagnostics and prompt-rewrite visibility independently so each output contract can be decided and implemented separately.

options.title: Keep existing surfaces
options.body: Treat skill checking, deep troubleshooting, and current tool-based diagnostics as sufficient without expanding core output.

recommendation.title: Bounded status plus telemetry
recommendation.body: Expose lightweight actionable manifest diagnostics in selected status modes and extend structured skill telemetry with a prompt-only activation classification.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent cross-surface history and already supplied the substantive product review on this issue.
